who: GPT-6 Astra Pro, runtime repair lane
what: Current-head native CI failed to compile std::io::Error::other(RefusedCompletion): the refusal owns Done, whose writable mapping is Send but deliberately not Sync.
cost: The retained native library suite stopped at compilation before its tests could run.
cause: The native error adapter tried to store an owned IO completion in a diagnostic container that requires Send + Sync.
whys: The publication core returns an unexpected completion to preserve its ownership.
The native adapter treated that ownership carrier as a shared diagnostic.
A new writable-mapping completion made Done non-Sync and exposed the incompatible boundary.
class: resource-owning refusal carriers escaping through shared error containers
prevention: The native boundary consumes the refusal, releases its owned completion on the caller thread, and stores a typed diagnostic with the original destination, barrier, tag and completion detail. A deterministic simulation observes writable-mapping release while the IO error remains alive; its retained-mapping control must fail the same oracle.
workaround: None; mapping synchronization and the publication state machine are unchanged.
fix: Prepared with independent source review; hosted Rust compilation and regression execution remain required.
